answer: An invitation is only renewed when the invited identity has produced work that a stranger attested, so waiting out a quarantine window is worthless and only per-identity attested work ages an account into the trusted tier. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. Picture a pigment verified individually, an island who has no stake in the farm, and an echo earned by both: skipping the pigment means skipping the island, and without the island there is no echo. Each head also needs a stranger to attest that work.
